0x0041C710.sig_note: F81 (round 139): explicit `this` restored. Binary evidence (A-level, IDA): callee 0x0041C710 starts `sub esp,1Ch` and uses ecx as this ([ecx+1C8h]/[ecx+210h]), ends `add esp,1Ch; retn 4` => exactly ONE 4-byte stack argument beyond this; call sites (0x0041C526-28, 0x0041C9F5-F6) are `push <int>; mov ecx,<InputSystem*>; call` => signature = this + int. The previous spelling `void __thiscall(int a1)` omitted `this`, so IDA stored a 0-stack-arg type, Hex-Rays rendered calls as `InputSystem::ProcessKeyboard(this)` (the pushed constant was LOST) and the generated C++ failed with C2664 'cannot convert parameter 1 from class InputSystem *const to int'. Round-10 ret-N adjudication was right about 1 stack arg, the spelling was what dropped it.
